title: Deepfake Zoom calls, Anthropic's IPO roadshow & ChatGPT GIFs | Daily AI & Tech
summary: Six AI and tech updates in under five minutes: deepfake video calls targeting crypto firms, Anthropic's IPO roadshow, NVIDIA's GR00T 2, ChatGPT animated GIFs, record US power demand and Meta's paused scraping terms.
hook_voice: A fake boss on a video call, Anthropic heading towards the stock market, and ChatGPT now makes GIFs. Here are today's biggest AI and tech updates.

stories.headline: Hackers use *deepfake* bosses on fake Zoom calls
stories.voice: North Korea linked hackers are joining video calls with deepfake versions of trusted crypto executives. Mid-call, the fake executive says your audio is broken and asks you to install a quick fix. That fix is malware. It's part of a bigger pattern: North Korea stole over two billion dollars in crypto in 2025.
points: Crypto companies are the main target

stat.label: crypto stolen by North Korea in 2025

stories.bot: My rule: if a call asks you to install anything, hang up and verify on another app!

stories.headline: Anthropic takes its *IPO* plans on the road
stories.voice: The company behind Claude has started its IPO roadshow. That's when a company pitches itself to big investors before listing its shares on the stock market. It's a major step for one of the biggest names in AI, and a sign of how much money is flowing into the industry.
points: The roadshow comes before a listing
Big investors get the pitch first

stories.headline: NVIDIA's *GR00T 2* learns from human video
stories.voice: NVIDIA's new robot model, GR00T 2, is testing a simple idea. Can robots learn new skills faster by watching videos of people doing tasks? If it works, teaching a robot could look more like showing it a video than programming every move.
stories.bot: Note to self: watch more cooking videos.

stories.headline: ChatGPT Images 2.6 makes *animated GIFs*
stories.voice: ChatGPT's image tool just got an update. Version 2.6 can now create animated GIFs, not just still pictures. Reference images also stay saved, so your characters and styles stay consistent. Developers get two new image models in the API too.

stories.headline: AI data centres push US power use to *records*
stories.voice: The US energy agency expects electricity use to hit new record highs in 2026 and again in 2027. A big part of the reason is AI. Data centres that train and run AI models need huge amounts of power, and that demand keeps growing.
points: AI data centres are a key driver

stories.headline: Meta pauses its *website-scraping* terms
stories.voice: Meta has paused new terms that would have let it scrape business users' websites. The move came after rulings in Norway and Brazil. For now the pause is indefinite, which is a small win for website owners worried about their content being used without asking.

question: Which update *surprised* you most?
outro_voice: That's today's update. Which story surprised you most? Tell me in the comments, and subscribe for daily AI and tech updates.
